ana: Quick heads-up — I opened a draft PR for the Dedicated provisioning docs that combines sample workflows, a small fallback matrix, and a couple SDK examples. PTAL when you have a minute: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/546 :wave:
jordan: Thanks — linking now. What specifically do you want reviewers to focus on? wording for SLAs, the autoscale policy examples, or the YAML layout?
ana: (typo: 'ana'!) Focus: 1) clarify autoscale examples (we added a burst vs steady example), 2) fallback behavior when capacity is constrained (matrix + behavioral notes), 3) a Python SDK snippet for reserving capacity. Also any link fixes if you spot broken anchors.
tara: I can look at the SDK snippet. Do you want the snippet to show error handling for preemption? That's a common ask from customers.
ana: Yes please — show a try/except and show how to fallback to a smaller model variant. We had an internal pattern for that — if you want I can paste it here.
mike: Pushing a small CLI/YAML example suggestion. Proposed YAML sample for reserved pool config:
```yaml
reserved_pool:
  name: prod-critical
  capacity: 4-gpu
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 8
  preemption_policy: best_effort
  fallback_strategy:
    - model_variant: gptx-8q
    - route: regional-fallback
```
And a quick Python SDK snippet to call Provision API and fallback:```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=REDWOOD_KEY)
try:
    pool = client.reserve_pool(name="prod-critical", gpu_count=4)
except client.errors.CapacityError as e:
    # fallback to shared hosted model
    print("fallbacking to hosted API", e)
    resp = client.hosted.generate("...", model="gptx-8q")
```
mike: (note: adjust import path if devex renames package)
devex-bot: docs-ci started for PR #546 — running build and spellcheck :construction:
docs-ci: build failed — lint error in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 42 (heading style). Please run `make docs-lint` locally or adjust the heading to match style.
nana: Thanks CI. I'll fix the heading and push. small patch coming.
jordan: One content nit: SLA wording currently says "best effort with alerting" — we should explicitly state which routes are SLA-backed vs best-effort. Can we add a short table in the SLA section? e.g., route type / SLA tier / fallback behavior.
tara: I'll draft that table. Also please add a migration note for Dedicated -> Private customers: they need to rebind keys and update the VPC egress list. Where should that live? in a migration note subsection or separate page?
mike: I'd put a short migration note in the provisioning page and link to a longer migration guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/dedicated-to-private-migration (stubbed). That way customers see the highlight immediately.
nana: Sounds good. @tara can you add that migration paragraph + link? If you add a 2-line callout it should be enough for now.
tara: On it. Also I'll include the preemption example error handling in the Python snippet, and reword the SLA sentence to "SLA-backed routes maintain X ms p95; best-effort routes may be preempted under capacity pressure" — is that ok?
jordan: Perfect. One more: the autoscale example uses a 15-minute window in the YAML; ops prefers 5m for bursty workloads. Maybe add both and recommend which to use by workload type.
nana: Good call. I'll add a short recommendation table: steady throughput -> 15m, bursty -> 5m with burst_policy enabled.
nana: Quick PR housekeeping — asking for reviewers: @jordan @tara. If you can review by EOD today we can merge once CI passes.
tara: I can do a pass by 16:30 PST.
jordan: I'll review after stand-up. :thumbsup:
nana: Thanks everyone. I pushed the lint fix and the tiny migration callout: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/7b3f2a1. Re-running docs-ci now.
docs-ci: docs-ci build queued... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
docs-ci: build succeeded — all checks passed :tada:
jordan: LGTM from me. Small nit I left inline on the PR about a link anchor.
tara: Approved, wording tweak applied.
mike: Nice — should we also add a short sample terraform snippet in a follow-up? I can open a mini-PR.
nana: Yes please — follow-up for Terraform snippet. I'll merge this after a final CI green and then we can add the TF example in a separate PR.
nana: Merging now. Thanks all! :rocket:
